hooks.command:
jq -c '(.cwd // "") as $cwd
| (.tool_input.command // "") as $full
| ($cwd | gsub("(?<c>[^[:alnum:]_/-])"; "\\" + .c)) as $dir
| (if $cwd == "" then $full else ($full | sub("^[[:space:]]*cd[[:space:]]+[\"\u0027]?" + $dir + "[\"\u0027]?[[:space:]]*(;|&&)[[:space:]]*"; "")) end) as $rest
| ($rest | sub("^(?<w>[[:space:]]*)npx[[:space:]]+vitest(?![^[:space:]])(?:[[:space:]]+run(?![^[:space:]]))?"; "\(.w)npm test -- --coverage.enabled=false")) as $run
| ($run
  | gsub("\\\\\n"; " ")
  | gsub("\"(?<d>[^\"]*)\"|\u0027(?<s>[^\u0027]*)\u0027"; ((.d // .s // "") as $q | if ($q | test("^[\\w./=:@-]+$")) then $q else "\"\"" end))
  | split("\n")
  | reduce .[] as $l ({w: null, out: []};
      if .w != null then (if ($l | sub("^\t+"; "")) == .w then .w = null else . end)
      else .out += [$l] | (($l | capture("<<-?[[:space:]]*(?<w>[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)[[:space:]]*$")) // null) as $m | if $m != null then .w = $m.w else . end
      end)
  | .out | join("\n")) as $head
| ($head | if ($rest | test("mutation"; "i")) then . else sub("(?<g>(^|[;&|(\n])[[:space:]]*gh[[:space:]]+api[[:space:]]+graphql[[:space:]]+)-f[[:space:]]+query=(\"\"|[^[:space:];&|()<>`$\"\\\\]*)(?=[[:space:];&|]|$)"; "\(.g)") end) as $api
| "(^|[;&|(\n])[[:space:]]*" as $at
| "(^|[;&(\n]|\\|\\|)[[:space:]]*" as $lead
| "Instead of npx, node -e or python3, use npm run lint -- --fix, npm run format, npm run typecheck, npm run e2e -- <file> -g \"<name>\", npm test -- --coverage.enabled=false <path> or npm run design:check -- -g \"design: <screen>\"." as $npm
| [
    [$at + "cd([[:space:]]|$)", "Do not cd: you start in the workspace, so give paths instead."],
    [$lead + "cat[[:blank:]]+[^[:space:]]", "Do not use cat: read a file with Read."],
    [$lead + "grep([[:space:]]|$)", "Do not use grep: search with git grep \"<pattern>\" -- \":!plans\", because old plans name paths that no longer exist; read your own plan by path."],
    [$lead + "head([[:space:]]|$)", "Do not use head: read a file with Read, which takes an offset and a limit."],
    [$lead + "ls([[:space:]]|$)", "Do not use ls: list files with git ls-files -co --exclude-standard \"<glob>\"; bash does not expand **."],
    [$lead + "sed([[:space:]]|$)", "Do not use sed: read a file with Read and change it with Edit."],
    [$at + "for[[:space:]]", "Do not use a for loop: run one command per Bash call."],
    [$at + "(npx|python3)([[:space:]]|$)", $npm],
    [$at + "node[[:space:]]+(-e|-p|--eval|--print)([[:space:]]|$)", $npm],
    [$at + "git[[:space:]]+grep[[:space:]]+([^\n;&|]*[[:space:]\"])?(-[^-[:space:]]*O|--op)", "Do not use git grep -O or --open-files-in-pager: it runs a command on each file."],
    [$at + "git[[:space:]]+(-|(config|remote|var)([[:space:]]|$)|ls-remote[[:space:]]+([^[:space:]]+[[:space:]]+)*--get-url)", "Do not read or change the git configuration or the remotes: the checkout is set up for you."],
    [$at + "gh[[:space:]]+(pr[[:space:]]+(review|merge|close|lock)|issue[[:space:]]+(close|delete|lock|transfer))([[:space:]]|$)", "Do not review, merge, close, lock, delete or transfer: a person does that."],
    [$at + "gh[[:space:]]+api[[:space:]]+([^\n;&|]*[[:space:]])?(-[XfF]|--(method|field|raw-field|input)([[:space:]=]|$))", "Use gh api to read only: comment with gh pr comment or gh issue comment, and change an issue with gh issue edit."],
    [$at + "gh[[:space:]]+([^\n;&|]*[[:space:]])?(--body-file(=|[[:space:]]+)|-F=?[[:space:]]*)(-[^[:space:]]|[^-=[:space:]])", "Give a body as --body-file - with a heredoc, not a file."]
  ] as $table
| (first($table[] | . as [$re, $msg] | select($api | test($re)) | $msg) // null) as $why
| if $why != null then
    {hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PreToolUse", permissionDecision: "deny", permissionDecisionReason: $why}}
  elif $run != $full then
    {hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PreToolUse", updatedInput: (.tool_input + {command: $run}), additionalContext: ([(if $rest != $full then "Dropped a leading cd into the workspace: you already run there." else empty end), (if $run != $rest then "Changed npx vitest to npm test -- --coverage.enabled=false: use that form." else empty end)] | join(" "))}}
  else empty end'
